grade.rationale: The candidate cleanly separates the retained G-12 snapshot ('versions before 4.2 affected') as historical from the current unavailability notice, so no false merge, stale-current leak, or lost history occurs, and the single change event matches the reference. The ledger's core unresolved item — that the current advisory status cannot be established from the unavailable page — is only implicitly covered; the candidate instead foregrounds peripheral invented unknowns (reason for removal, product identity, 4.2+ status), which the rules do not reward. Its one current truth (the URL is currently unavailable) is source-supported even though the ledger carries no current truths. Every factual claim traces to the two snapshots, so there are no unsupported claims.
